source_dataset: Nepal Flood 2026 Municipal WASH Database (existing compilation)
use_in_analysis: Population, hard-hit wards, RDNA impacts, initial damaged-WSS map, MICS context
key_limitation_handling: Contains mixed source dates; blanks must not be read as zero

source_dataset: Government: Details of Damage in the Drinking Water Sector
use_in_analysis: Named damaged WSS, damage cost, beneficiary population
key_limitation_handling: Published district totals not independently reconciled; analysis uses individual project rows

source_dataset: Municipality indicator extract provided by user
use_in_analysis: Drinking-water access, sanitation, poverty, child vulnerability, WASH-related baseline scores
key_limitation_handling: Original extract did not contain the affected Gandaki/Tanahu municipalities; the same indicator definitions were later supplemented through S13. Do not impute other missing values.

source_dataset: Nepal Logistics & Telecommunications Cluster meeting minutes, 29 Sep 2026
use_in_analysis: Latest physical-access context for Rasuwa/Nuwakot corridor
key_limitation_handling: Dynamic; route-level evidence should not be treated as precise municipality-level status

source_dataset: Nepal Logistics Concept of Operations, Sep/Oct 2026
use_in_analysis: Access constraints and hard-to-reach context
key_limitation_handling: Broad operational context; not a municipal road-condition inventory

source_dataset: Kathmandu Post: E. coli in flood-hit Bidur
use_in_analysis: Confirmed water-quality concern
key_limitation_handling: Single municipality; should not be extrapolated to other locations

source_dataset: Kathmandu Post: water shortages and disease risk in holding centres
use_in_analysis: Current water access, temporary supply, displacement-site WASH
key_limitation_handling: Conditions are time-sensitive and location-specific

source_dataset: RRN consolidated flood summary
use_in_analysis: WSS restoration, pipe dispatch, tanker supply, water testing
key_limitation_handling: Some items aggregate multiple initiatives and may be repeated in later updates

source_dataset: INSEC: Galchhi flood impacts
use_in_analysis: Current water-access disruption and affected households
key_limitation_handling: Localized evidence, not municipality-wide

source_dataset: OnlineKhabar: drinking water restored in Galchhi
use_in_analysis: Latest restoration status for one scheme / 180 households
key_limitation_handling: Localized restoration does not imply full municipal recovery

source_dataset: WHO: post-disaster surveillance after Nepal floods
use_in_analysis: WASH-health risk, displacement, difficult access, water-quality monitoring
key_limitation_handling: Broad affected-area evidence rather than municipality scoring

source_dataset: Oxfam Rapid Integrated Emergency Needs & Markets Assessment
use_in_analysis: Field triangulation, WASH observation, holding-centre and access evidence
key_limitation_handling: Direct access to Uttargaya Wards 1–3 was not possible; findings there remain provisional

source_dataset: Gandaki Province municipality indicator extract provided by user
use_in_analysis: Drinking-water access, sanitation and poverty/inequality inputs for affected municipalities in Gorkha and Tanahu
key_limitation_handling: Only the same P3 indicators already used elsewhere are scored; other CCRI indicators remain contextual to avoid overlap

source_dataset: 2026 affected-population estimates (Flash Appeal / response-planning compilation)
use_in_analysis: Direct scoring input: affected population used in P1 and in population-share calculations.
key_limitation_handling: Affected population is distinct from population residing in affected wards.
file_url: Nepal WASH Cluster severity-analysis master inputs

source_dataset: PDNA raw water-supply-system assessment data
use_in_analysis: Direct scoring input: assessed WSS beneficiary population and physical damage inform P1; current service status and drinking-water safety/public-health inform P2.
key_limitation_handling: Scheme beneficiary populations may overlap and are not unique people. Coverage ratios are capped at 100%. Exact infrastructure coordinates are not published.
file_url: Nepal WASH Cluster controlled PDNA raw dataset

source_dataset: IOM holding-centre / site-level assessment
use_in_analysis: Supporting/map context only: holding-centre locations and site-level WASH/displacement information.
key_limitation_handling: Site-level evidence is not treated as municipality-wide coverage and is not a direct v15 severity-score component.
file_url: IOM assessment shared with Nepal response

source_dataset: Nepal administrative boundaries
use_in_analysis: Mapping and PCODE-based joins for the 17 affected municipalities and available ward boundaries.
key_limitation_handling: Boundaries are used for spatial display and joins; they do not change severity scores.
file_url: Official Nepal administrative boundary layer supplied for the response analysis

source_dataset: 2026 flood-extent GIS layer
use_in_analysis: Map/context layer showing the flood footprint.
key_limitation_handling: Displayed as spatial context; not used as a standalone scoring variable in final v15.
file_url: Flood-extent GIS layer supplied for the Nepal flood response

source_dataset: Operational road-status layer
use_in_analysis: Map context and physical-access evidence; source attributes include NDRRMA and WFP updates.
key_limitation_handling: Road status is dynamic and route-level; it should not be read as a complete municipality-wide road inventory.

source_dataset: OpenStreetMap / CARTO basemap
use_in_analysis: Platform basemap only.
key_limitation_handling: Basemap is for orientation and does not affect analytical scores.
